ai_description: A plant reactor Log Book / Batch Card (e.g. the R-850 Stirred Reactor Log Book or a General Batch Card for Blending/Formulated/Reaction). Each batch is a mostly-handwritten record spanning a printed grid page (reactor, batch no, product, raw materials with recipe/actual quantities, process-step start/finish times, QC in-process analysis, and complete analysis/specification) plus a lined 'Shift Process Activities' page carrying the free-text remarks narrative. The printed product name is often struck through with the real product handwritten over it. One batch = one register row; a product folder holds several batches.
notes: engine=logbook: uploads (many mobile-photo images of log-book pages) are classified per page (main grid vs remarks narrative), extracted individually via the shared AI gateway, then assembled into batches (main page + its remarks page) and written to a single combined Excel register — one row per batch. Scales to hundreds of images.
